nativeRendererAndPrivateSmtp.transport: Native WordPress/PHP cURL over real TLS to Caddy and the unmodified renderer container. Local fixture CA trusted explicitly; private Docker hostname permitted only in the fixture. No pre_http_request response substitution. Initial phases capture PHPMailer MIME. The separate SMTP phase uses the unmodified WordPress mailer, WooCommerce Action Scheduler, wp-cron.php and a private Mailpit inbox with no external relay.
